Educational Resources

Clinically reviewed by Dr Jeremy Sun Mingfa. Dr Sun is a Senior Consultant Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon in Singapore with dedicated fellowship-level training in lymphatic surgery, lymphovenous bypass (LVA), ICG lymphography and supermicrosurgical lymphatic reconstruction. This page is intended for general education and does not replace personalised medical assessment.

Educational Resources

Lymphovenous shunts (PDF)

A review article published by our founder on the various techniques utilised for lymphovenous shunts/bypass.

Genital elephantiasis (PDF)

A review article published by our founder on advanced genital lymphedema and how to effectively treat this disease entity.

Surgical prevention of lymphedema (PDF)

A review article published by our founder on primary and secondary prevention of lymphedema. The pros and cons of this approach is explored.

Featured on NHK documentary

Dr. Jeremy Sun appeared on the NHK documentary "The Professionals" during his lymphedema training at the Supermicrosurgery International Lymphedema Center (SILC) in Tokyo, where he learned from his mentor, Dr. Takumi Yamamoto. Open the NHK programme page.
